ICS 75.140PCD 06Revised Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and tests for cutback bitumen produced by fluxing bitumen with distillates of petroleum for use in road construction.2. ReferencesThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
